hook: Leaves don't TURN yellow in autumn.

scenes.text: All summer, green chlorophyll soaks up sunlight and covers every other colour
When the days get shorter and colder, the tree stops making it
The yellow and orange pigments were underneath the whole time
Red is different: many trees make it fresh, right in autumn
Then the tree seals off the stem... and lets the leaf go

end: Follow for more things you never noticed
